WITH
  forecast_bnm AS (
    SELECT
      article,
      fiscal_year_week,
      train_test_label,
      sum(qty) AS total_qty,
      sum(predicted_quantity) AS total_predicted_qty
    FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.{ADA Historical Forecast Table}`
    WHERE channel <> '{Ecom Channel Name}'
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  ),
  forecast_ecom AS (
    SELECT
      article,
      fiscal_year_week,
      train_test_label,
      sum(qty) AS total_qty,
      sum(predicted_quantity) AS total_predicted_qty
    FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.{ADA Historical Forecast Table}`
    WHERE channel = '{Ecom Channel Name}'
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  ),
  prod_master_bnm AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      article,
      COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) AS prod_cnt
    FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.{ADA Historical Forecast Table}`
    WHERE
      article IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT article
        FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.{ADA Historical Forecast Table}`
        WHERE channel <> '{Ecom Channel Name}'
      )
    GROUP BY 1
  ),
  prod_master_ecom AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      article,
      COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) AS prod_cnt
    FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.{ADA Historical Forecast Table}`
    WHERE
      article IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT article
        FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.{ADA Historical Forecast Table}`
        WHERE channel = '{Ecom Channel Name}'
      )
    GROUP BY 1
  ),
  prop_bnm AS (
    SELECT
      a.*,
      b.prod_cnt,
      c.product_code,
      round(a.total_qty / b.prod_cnt) AS qty_prod_prop,
      (a.total_predicted_qty / b.prod_cnt) AS predicted_qty_prod_prop
    FROM forecast_bnm a
    INNER JOIN prod_master_bnm b
      ON a.article = b.article
    INNER JOIN `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_sku_hierarchy` c
      ON
        a.article = c.article
  ),
  prop_ecom AS (
    SELECT
      a.*,
      b.prod_cnt,
      c.product_code,
      round(a.total_qty / b.prod_cnt) AS qty_prod_prop,
      (a.total_predicted_qty / b.prod_cnt) AS predicted_qty_prod_prop
    FROM forecast_ecom a
    INNER JOIN prod_master_ecom b
      ON a.article = b.article
    INNER JOIN `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_sku_hierarchy` c
      ON
        a.article = c.article
  ),
  final AS (
    SELECT
      product_code,
      fiscal_year_week,
      qty_prod_prop AS quantity,
      predicted_qty_prod_prop AS predicted_qty,
    FROM prop_bnm
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      product_code,
      fiscal_year_week,
      qty_prod_prop AS quantity,
      predicted_qty_prod_prop AS predicted_qty,
    FROM prop_ecom
  )
SELECT
  product_code,
  fiscal_year_week,
  SUM(quantity) AS quantity,
  SUM(predicted_qty) AS predicted_qty
FROM final
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY product_code, fiscal_year_week;

WITH
  po_info AS (
    SELECT
      product_code,
      channel,
      loc_code,
      po_id,
      CONCAT(style, '_', size, '_', po_id)
        AS reconciliation_id,  -- Can be Client Specific But should align with the logic for reconciliation_id, Some might use Style in Concat
      projected_delivery_date,
      0 AS quantity_ordered,  -- If you dont have this Column , use 0 as for phase 1, Column not being used anywhere
      oo,
      it
    FROM
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_po_master`
    JOIN
      (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          product_code,
          l0_name,
          l1_name,
          l2_name,
          l3_name,
          l4_name,
          l5_name,
          style,
          size
        FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_sku_hierarchy`
      ) pm  -- Map your hierarchy to the column names required as per your clients
      USING (product_code)
  ),
  order_to_po AS (
    SELECT
      product_code,
      channel,
      loc_code,
      po_to_order_processing
    FROM
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_constraints_lead_time` olt
    JOIN
      (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          product_code,
          l0_name,
          l1_name,
          l2_name,
          l3_name,
          l4_name,
          l5_name,
          style,
          size,
          article
        FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_sku_hierarchy`
      ) pm  -- Map your hierarchy to the column names required as per your clients
      USING (article)
  ),
  reconciliation_po AS (
    SELECT
      product_code,
      reconciliation_id,
      loc_code,
      quantity_ordered,
      po_to_order_processing,
      DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), order_placement_date, DAY) AS diff,
      CASE
        WHEN oo + it >= order_quantity THEN 'FULL'
        WHEN oo + it < order_quantity THEN 'PARTIAL'
        ELSE 'NONE'
        END
        AS reconciliation_status
    FROM
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_orders_approved` ooa
    LEFT JOIN
      po_info
      USING (product_code, loc_code, reconciliation_id)
    LEFT JOIN
      order_to_po
      USING (product_code, loc_code)
  ),
  required_po AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM
      reconciliation_po
    WHERE
      (reconciliation_status = 'FULL')
      OR (reconciliation_status = 'PARTIAL' AND diff > po_to_order_processing)
      OR (reconciliation_status = 'NONE' AND diff > po_to_order_processing)
  )
SELECT
  ooa.product_code,
  l0_name,
  pm.l1_name,
  pm.l2_name,
  pm.l3_name,
  pm.l4_name,
  l5_name,
  style,
  pm.article,
  pm.size,
  vendor_code,
  oo,
  it,
  projected_delivery_date,
  order_quantity,
  po_id,
  po_to_order_processing,
  order_placement_date,
  order_placement_recom_date,
  editable_expected_receipt_date,
  order_batch_name,
  order_gen_type,
  reconciliation_status,
  created_at,
  created_by,
  diff AS days_since_approved,
  current_timestamp AS deleted_at
FROM
  `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_orders_approved` ooa
JOIN
  required_po rp
  USING (product_code, loc_code, reconciliation_id)
JOIN
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      product_code,
      l0_name,
      l1_name,
      l2_name,
      l3_name,
      l4_name,
      l5_name,
      style,
      size,
      article
    FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_sku_hierarchy`
  ) pm  -- Map your hierarchy to the column names required as per your clients
  USING (product_code)
LEFT JOIN
  po_info po
  USING (product_code, loc_code, reconciliation_id)

WITH
  week_periods AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(fiscal_year_week AS STRING) AS time_period_key,
      'WEEK' AS time_period_type,
      fiscal_year,
      fiscal_week AS fiscal_period,
      fiscal_week_begin_date AS period_start_date,
      fiscal_week_end_date AS period_end_date,
      CAST(fiscal_year_month AS STRING) AS parent_time_period_key,
      'MONTH' AS parent_time_period_type
    FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.fiscal_date_mapping`
    WHERE fiscal_year_week IS NOT NULL
  ),
  month_periods AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(fiscal_year_month AS STRING) AS time_period_key,
      'MONTH' AS time_period_type,
      fiscal_year,
      fiscal_month AS fiscal_period,
      fiscal_month_begin_date AS period_start_date,
      fiscal_month_end_date AS period_end_date,
      CAST(fiscal_year_quarter AS STRING) AS parent_time_period_key,
      'QUARTER' AS parent_time_period_type
    FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.fiscal_date_mapping`
    WHERE fiscal_year_month IS NOT NULL
  ),
  quarter_periods AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(fiscal_year_quarter AS STRING) AS time_period_key,
      'QUARTER' AS time_period_type,
      fiscal_year,
      fiscal_quarter AS fiscal_period,
      fiscal_quarter_begin_date AS period_start_date,
      fiscal_quarter_end_date AS period_end_date,
      CONCAT(
        CAST(fiscal_year AS STRING),
        CASE WHEN fiscal_quarter IN (1, 2) THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END)
        AS parent_time_period_key,
      'HALF-YEAR' AS parent_time_period_type
    FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.fiscal_date_mapping`
    WHERE fiscal_year_quarter IS NOT NULL
  ),
  half_year_periods AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CONCAT(
        CAST(fiscal_year AS STRING),
        CASE WHEN fiscal_quarter IN (1, 2) THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END)
        AS time_period_key,
      'HALF-YEAR' AS time_period_type,
      fiscal_year,
      CASE WHEN fiscal_quarter IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS fiscal_period,
      MIN(fiscal_quarter_begin_date)
        OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            fiscal_year, CASE WHEN fiscal_quarter IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
        ) AS period_start_date,
      MAX(fiscal_quarter_end_date)
        OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            fiscal_year, CASE WHEN fiscal_quarter IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
        ) AS period_end_date,
      CAST(fiscal_year AS STRING) AS parent_time_period_key,
      'YEAR' AS parent_time_period_type
    FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.fiscal_date_mapping`
    WHERE fiscal_year IS NOT NULL
  ),
  year_periods AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(fiscal_year AS STRING) AS time_period_key,
      'YEAR' AS time_period_type,
      fiscal_year,
      CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS fiscal_period,
      fiscal_year_begin_date AS period_start_date,
      fiscal_year_end_date AS period_end_date,
      CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS parent_time_period_key,
      CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS parent_time_period_type
    FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.fiscal_date_mapping`
    WHERE fiscal_year IS NOT NULL
  ),
  all_periods AS (
    SELECT * FROM week_periods
    UNION DISTINCT
    SELECT * FROM month_periods
    UNION DISTINCT
    SELECT * FROM quarter_periods
    UNION DISTINCT
    SELECT * FROM half_year_periods
    UNION DISTINCT
    SELECT * FROM year_periods
  ),
  numbered AS (
    SELECT
      ROW_NUMBER()
        OVER (
          ORDER BY
            fiscal_year,
            CASE time_period_type
              WHEN 'YEAR' THEN 1
              WHEN 'HALF-YEAR' THEN 2
              WHEN 'QUARTER' THEN 3
              WHEN 'MONTH' THEN 4
              WHEN 'WEEK' THEN 5
              END,
            fiscal_period,
            period_start_date
        ) AS time_period_id,

WITH
  cte1 AS (
    SELECT
      product_code,
      CAST(COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(min_replenishment_quantity), 0), NULL) AS int)
        AS min_order_quantity_sku,
      CAST(COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(max_replenishment_quantity), 0), NULL) AS int)
        AS max_order_quantity_sku
    FROM
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_constraints_vendor_moq`
    JOIN
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_sku_hierarchy` pm
      USING (product_code)
    WHERE
      level_of_application = 'applicable_all'
    GROUP BY
      1
  ),
  cte2 AS (
    SELECT
      product_code,
      CAST(COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(min_replenishment_quantity), 0), NULL) AS int)
        AS min_order_quantity_style,
      CAST(COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(max_replenishment_quantity), 0), NULL) AS int)
        AS max_order_quantity_style
    FROM
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_constraints_vendor_moq`
    WHERE
      JSON_VALUE(rcl_dimension, '$.article') IS NOT NULL
      AND level_of_application = 'sum_all'
    GROUP BY
      1
  ),
  final AS (
    WITH
      store_oh_inv AS (
        SELECT
          COALESCE(sm.parent_sku, li.product_code) AS product_code,
          linked_store_code AS loc_code,
          SUM(GREATEST(total_inv, 0)) AS store_inv
        FROM
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_latest_inventory` li
        JOIN
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.store_dc_mapping` sdm
          USING (store_code)
        JOIN
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.distribution_centres` dc
          USING (dc_code)
        JOIN
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.dc_transit_time_mapping` dtt
          USING (mapping_code)
        LEFT JOIN
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_supersession_mapping` sm
          ON
            sm.child_sku = li.product_code
            AND CURRENT_DATE() BETWEEN from_date AND to_date
        WHERE
          store_type = 'store'
          AND sdm.is_active = TRUE
          AND dtt.priority = 1
        GROUP BY
          1,
          2
      ),
      dc_oh_inv AS (
        SELECT
          COALESCE(sm.parent_sku, li.product_code) AS product_code,
          loc_code,
          SUM(GREATEST(total_inv, 0)) AS dc_inv
        FROM
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_latest_inventory` li
        LEFT JOIN
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_supersession_mapping` sm
          ON
            sm.child_sku = li.product_code
            AND CURRENT_DATE() BETWEEN from_date AND to_date
        WHERE
          store_type = 'loc'
        GROUP BY
          1,
          2
      ),
      open_receipts AS (
        SELECT
          COALESCE(sm.parent_sku, pm.product_code) AS product_code,
          loc_code,
          SUM(GREATEST(0, oo + it + IFNULL(pseudo_po, 0))) AS open_receipt_units
        FROM
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_po_master` pm
        LEFT JOIN
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_supersession_mapping` sm
          ON
            sm.child_sku = pm.product_code
            AND CURRENT_DATE() BETWEEN from_date AND to_date
        GROUP BY
          1,
          2
      )
    SELECT DISTINCT
      pm.product_code,
      pm.loc_code,
      pm.channel,
      pm.vendor_code,
      pm.vendor_name,
      CAST(COALESCE(store_inv, 0) AS INT64) AS store_inv,
      CAST(COALESCE(dc_inv, 0) AS INT64) AS dc_inv,
      CAST((COALESCE(store_inv, 0) + COALESCE(dc_inv, 0)) AS INT64)
        AS system_inv,
      CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS mrpc,
      CAST(COALESCE(open_receipt_units, 0) AS INT64) AS open_receipt_units,
      0 AS safety_stock,
      112 AS created_by,
      CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
      CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS updated_by,
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS updated_at,
      CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS column_updated,
      CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS effective_lead_time,
      CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS adjusted_forecast_qty_4w,
      CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS adjusted_forecast_qty_4w_lc,
      CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS adjusted_forecast_qty_8w,
      CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS adjusted_forecast_qty_8w_lc,
      CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS adjusted_forecast_qty_12w,
      CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS adjusted_forecast_qty_12w_lc,
      CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS wos,
      CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS target_service_level,
      CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS ss_base,
      CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS safety_stock_sl,
      1 AS order_multiple,
      COALESCE(min_order_quantity_style, NULL) AS min_order_quantity_style,
      COALESCE(max_order_quantity_style, NULL) AS max_order_quantity_style,
      COALESCE(min_order_quantity_sku, NULL) AS min_order_quantity_sku,
      COALESCE(max_order_quantity_sku, NULL) AS max_order_quantity_sku,
      min_replenishment_quantity AS min_order_quantity_shipment,
      max_replenishment_quantity AS max_order_quantity_shipment,
      fm.fiscal_year_week AS year_week
    FROM
      (
        SELECT
          product_code,
          store_code AS loc_code,
          vendor_code,
          vendor_name,
          '-' AS channel,
          a.min_order_quantity_sku,
          a.max_order_quantity_sku,
          b.min_order_quantity_style,
          b.max_order_quantity_style
        FROM
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_sku_hierarchy`
        JOIN {Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_dc_product_mapping
          USING (product_code)
        JOIN
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_product_hybrid_attributes` pha
          USING (product_code)
        LEFT JOIN
          cte1 a
          USING (product_code)
        LEFT JOIN
          cte2 b
          USING (product_code)
        WHERE
          pha.ordering = 'Y'
      ) pm
    LEFT JOIN
      store_oh_inv s
      ON
        pm.product_code = s.product_code
        AND pm.loc_code = s.loc_code
    LEFT JOIN
      dc_oh_inv l
      ON
        pm.product_code = l.product_code
        AND pm.loc_code = l.loc_code
    LEFT JOIN
      open_receipts o
      ON
        pm.product_code = o.product_code
        AND pm.loc_code = o.loc_code
    LEFT JOIN
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_constraints_shipment` ocs

        pm.product_code = ocs.product_code
        AND pm.loc_code = ocs.loc_code
    JOIN
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_fiscal_date_mapping` fm
      ON
        fm.calendar_date = CURRENT_DATE()
  )

WITH
  base AS (
    SELECT
      article,
      channel,
      start_date,
      end_date,
      rule_code,
      pp_code,
      created_at,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY article, channel, pp_code) AS count_pp_code,
      RANK()
        OVER (PARTITION BY article, channel ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rnk
    FROM
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.resolved_product_profile` a
    JOIN
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_sku_hierarchy` b
      USING (product_code)
    JOIN
      (
        SELECT
          product_code
        FROM
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_product_hybrid_attributes`
        WHERE
          ordering = 'Y'
      )
      USING (product_code)
  ),
  date_series_resolved_table AS (
    SELECT
      article,
      channel,
      start_date,
      end_date,
      rule_code,
      pp_code,
      DATE_ADD(start_date, INTERVAL x DAY) AS date_in_series
    FROM
      (
        SELECT
          *
        FROM
          (
            SELECT
              *,
              MAX(count_pp_code)
                OVER (PARTITION BY article, channel) AS max_count_pp_code
            FROM
              base
          )
        WHERE
          count_pp_code = max_count_pp_code
          AND rnk = 1
      )
    CROSS JOIN
      UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, DATE_DIFF(end_date, start_date, DAY), 1)) AS x
  )
SELECT DISTINCT
  article,
  channel,
  fiscal_year_week,
  rule_code,
  pp_code
FROM date_series_resolved_table
JOIN `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_fiscal_date_mapping` fdm
  ON DATE(fdm.calendar_date) = date_in_series

      l2_name,
      l3_name,  -- You can input client specific product and time hierarchy list based on level at which budget is defined. This query is given for reference only.

    JOIN `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_sku_hierarchy`
      USING (l1_name, l2_name, l3_name)

    GROUP BY
      fiscal_year_week,
      l1_name,
      l2_name,
      l3_name
  ),
  po AS (
    SELECT
      fiscal_year_week AS time_period_key,
      l1_name,
      l2_name,
      l3_name,
      SUM(po_units) AS po_units,
      SUM(po_cost) AS po_cost
    FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.po_master`
    JOIN `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_sku_hierarchy`
      USING (level)  -- you can join with level of the tables
    JOIN `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.fiscal_date_mapping` f
      USING (level)  -- you can join with level of the tables
    WHERE
      DATE(deliverydate) > f.date
      AND l3_name IS NOT NULL
      AND fiscal_year_week IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
      fiscal_year_week,
      l1_name,
      l2_name,
      l3_name
  ),
  base AS (
    SELECT
      p.time_period_key,
      p.l1_name,
      p.l2_name,
      p.l3_name,
      GREATEST(p.planned_budget_units, 0) AS planned_budget_units,
      GREATEST(p.planned_budget_cost, 0) AS planned_budget_cost,
      COALESCE(po.po_units, 0) AS po_units,
      COALESCE(po.po_cost, 0) AS po_cost

WITH
  actual_po AS (
    SELECT
      '-' AS order_id,
      po_id,
      '-' AS asn_id,
      product_code,
      store_code AS loc_code,
      '-' AS channel,
      po_approval_date,
      projected_delivery_date,
      oo,
      it,
      CAST(NULL AS int64) AS pseudo_po
    FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.po_master`
    JOIN `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_product_hybrid_attributes`
      USING (product_code)
    WHERE ordering = 'Y' AND expected_delivery_date >= current_date()
  ),
  pending_review_po AS (
    SELECT
      product_code,
      loc_code,
      '-' AS channel,
      fiscal_year_week,
      order_status_id,
      FORMAT_DATE(
        '%Y-%m-%d',
        PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', REGEXP_EXTRACT(order_batch_name, r'(\d{8})')))
        AS our_transfer_date,
      order_quantity,
      created_at,
      editable_expected_receipt_date
    FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_orders_recommended`
    WHERE order_status_id IN (-1, 1)
  ),
  pending_review_po_final AS (
    SELECT
      concat(
        product_code, "-", loc_code, "-", channel, "-", projected_delivery_date)
        AS order_id,
      "-" AS po_id,
      "-" AS asn_id,
      product_code,
      loc_code,
      "-" AS channel,
      projected_delivery_date,
      CAST(NULL AS int64) AS oo,
      CAST(NULL AS int64) AS it,
      order_quantity AS pseudo_po
    FROM
      (
        SELECT
          product_code,
          loc_code,
          channel,
          CAST(our_transfer_date AS date) our_transfer_date,
          editable_expected_receipt_date AS projected_delivery_date,
          sum(order_quantity) order_quantity
        FROM pending_review_po a
        GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
      ) a
    WHERE current_date() BETWEEN our_transfer_date AND our_transfer_date + 7
  ),
  approved_orders AS (
    SELECT
      product_code,
      loc_code,
      "-" AS channel,
      po_to_order_processing,
      order_quantity,
      approved_date,
      projected_delivery_date
    FROM
      (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          product_code,
          loc_code,
          DATE(created_at) AS approved_date,
          po_to_order_processing,
          editable_expected_receipt_date AS projected_delivery_date,
          sum(order_quantity) AS order_quantity
        FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_orders_approved` c
        JOIN
          (
            SELECT product_code, loc_code, po_to_order_processing
            FROM {Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_constraints_lead_time a
            JOIN {Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_sku_hierarchy b
              USING (article)
          ) d
          USING (product_code, loc_code)
        WHERE order_status_id IN (3)
        GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
      )
  ),
  approved_orders_match AS (
    SELECT product_code, loc_code
    FROM actual_po a
    JOIN approved_orders b
      USING (product_code, loc_code)
    WHERE
      current_date()
        BETWEEN approved_date
        AND approved_date + po_to_order_processing
      AND po_approval_date
        BETWEEN approved_date
        AND approved_date + po_to_order_processing
  ),
  approved_orders_final AS (
    SELECT
      concat(
        product_code, "-", loc_code, "-", channel, "-", projected_delivery_date)
        AS order_id,
      "-" AS po_id,
      "-" AS asn_id,
      product_code,
      loc_code,
      "-" AS channel,
      projected_delivery_date,
      CAST(NULL AS int64) AS oo,
      CAST(NULL AS int64) AS it,
      order_quantity AS pseudo_po
    FROM approved_orders
    WHERE
      concat(product_code, loc_code)
      NOT IN (
        SELECT concat(product_code, loc_code)
        FROM approved_orders_match
      )
  ),
  final_po_data AS (
    SELECT * EXCEPT (po_approval_date)
    FROM actual_po
    UNION ALL
    SELECT *
    FROM pending_review_po_final
    UNION ALL
    SELECT *
    FROM approved_orders_final
  )
SELECT
  order_id,
  po_id,
  asn_id,
  product_code,
  loc_code,
  channel,
  projected_delivery_date,
  b.fiscal_year_week,
  oo,
  it,
  pseudo_po,
  0 AS quantity_ordered,
  CAST(112 AS INT64) AS created_by,
  CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
  CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS updated_by,
  CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS updated_at,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS column_updated,
  NULL AS row_num,
  NULL AS id
FROM final_po_data a
JOIN {Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_fiscal_date_mapping b
  ON a.projected_delivery_date = b.calendar_date

WITH
  scheduler AS (
    SELECT
      sh_name,
      JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(sh_structure, "$.data.dailyRepeatOn")
        AS dailyRepeatOn,
      CASE
        WHEN
          REGEXP_CONTAINS(
            JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(sh_structure, "$.data.start_date"),
            r'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$')
          THEN
            CAST(
              PARSE_DATE(
                '%Y-%m-%d',
                JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(sh_structure, "$.data.start_date"))
              AS DATE)
        ELSE
          COALESCE(
            CAST(
              PARSE_TIMESTAMP(
                '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%E*S',
                REGEXP_REPLACE(
                  JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(sh_structure, "$.data.start_date"),
                  r'(\.\d+)?Z$',
                  ''))
              AS DATE),
            DATE('2000-01-01'))
        END AS start_date,
      CASE
        WHEN
          JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(sh_structure, "$.data.end_date_options")
          = 'never_ending'
          THEN DATE('9999-12-31')
        WHEN
          REGEXP_CONTAINS(
            JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(sh_structure, "$.data.end_date"),
            r'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$')
          THEN
            CAST(
              PARSE_DATE(
                '%Y-%m-%d',
                JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(sh_structure, "$.data.end_date"))
              AS DATE)
        ELSE
          COALESCE(
            CAST(
              PARSE_TIMESTAMP(
                '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%E*S',
                REGEXP_REPLACE(
                  JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(sh_structure, "$.data.end_date"),
                  r'(\.\d+)?Z$',
                  ''))
              AS DATE),
            DATE('9999-12-31'))
        END AS end_date,
      JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(sh_structure, "$.data.end_date_options")
        AS end_date_options,
      CAST(
        JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(sh_structure, "$.data.num_of_occurrence") AS INT64)
        AS num_of_occurrence,
      JSON_VALUE(sh_structure, '$.data.month_toggle.value')
        AS month_toggle_value,
      JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(sh_structure, "$.data.frequency_type")
        AS frequency_type,
      JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(sh_structure, "$.frequency_type")
        AS frequency_type_global,
      JSON_VALUE(value1) AS selectedWeeks,
      CAST(JSON_VALUE(value2) AS int) AS selectedDatesForMonthly,
      JSON_VALUE(value3) AS selectedDaysForMonthly,
      CAST(JSON_VALUE(value4) AS int) AS selectedWeeksForMonthly,
      CAST(JSON_VALUE(value5) AS int) AS selectedDatesForQuaterly,
      JSON_VALUE(value6) AS selectedDaysForQuaterly,
      CAST(JSON_VALUE(value7) AS int) AS selectedWeeksForQuarterly,
      CAST(JSON_VALUE(value8) AS int) AS selectedMonths,
      CAST(JSON_VALUE(value9) AS int) AS selectedDatesForYearly,
      JSON_VALUE(value10) AS selectedDaysForYearly,
      CAST(JSON_VALUE(value11) AS int) AS selectedWeeksForYearly,
      JSON_VALUE(value12) AS selectedMonthsForYearly
    FROM
      (
        SELECT
          sh_code,
          sh_name,
          PARSE_JSON(sh_structure) AS sh_structure,
          sh_frequency,
          is_deleted,
          created_by,
          created_at,
          updated_by,
          updated_at,
          is_deletable
        FROM
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.auto_allocation_scheduler`
      ) AS base,
      UNNEST(
        IF(
          ARRAY_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedWeeks"))
            = 0,
          ARRAY<JSON>[NULL],
          JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedWeeks"))) AS value1,
      UNNEST(
        IF(
          ARRAY_LENGTH(
            JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedDatesForMonthly"))
            = 0,
          ARRAY<JSON>[NULL],
          JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedDatesForMonthly")))
        AS value2,
      UNNEST(
        IF(
          ARRAY_LENGTH(
            JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedDaysForMonthly"))
            = 0,
          ARRAY<JSON>[NULL],
          JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedDaysForMonthly")))
        AS value3,
      UNNEST(
        IF(
          ARRAY_LENGTH(
            JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedWeeksForMonthly"))
            = 0,
          ARRAY<JSON>[NULL],
          JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedWeeksForMonthly")))
        AS value4,
      UNNEST(
        IF(
          ARRAY_LENGTH(
            JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedDatesForQuaterly"))
            = 0,
          ARRAY<JSON>[NULL],
          JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedDatesForQuaterly")))
        AS value5,
      UNNEST(
        IF(
          ARRAY_LENGTH(
            JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedDaysForQuaterly"))
            = 0,
          ARRAY<JSON>[NULL],
          JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedDaysForQuaterly")))
        AS value6,
      UNNEST(
        IF(
          ARRAY_LENGTH(
            JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(
              sh_structure, "$.data.selectedWeeksForQuarterly"))
            = 0,
          ARRAY<JSON>[NULL],
          JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedWeeksForQuarterly")))
        AS value7,
      UNNEST(
        IF(
          ARRAY_LENGTH(
            JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedMonths"))
            = 0,
          ARRAY<JSON>[NULL],
          JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedMonths"))) AS value8,
      UNNEST(
        IF(
          ARRAY_LENGTH(
            JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedDatesForYearly"))
            = 0,
          ARRAY<JSON>[NULL],
          JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedDatesForYearly")))
        AS value9,
      UNNEST(
        IF(
          ARRAY_LENGTH(
            JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedDaysForYearly"))
            = 0,
          ARRAY<JSON>[NULL],
          JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedDaysForYearly")))
        AS value10,
      UNNEST(
        IF(
          ARRAY_LENGTH(
            JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedWeeksForYearly"))
            = 0,
          ARRAY<JSON>[NULL],
          JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedWeeksForYearly")))
        AS value11,
      UNNEST(
        IF(
          ARRAY_LENGTH(
            JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedMonthsForYearly"))
            = 0,
          ARRAY<JSON>[NULL],
          JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(sh_structure, "$.data.selectedMonthsForYearly")))
        AS value12
    WHERE
      sh_name IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT scheduler
        FROM `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_constraints_order_policy`
        WHERE replenishment_strategy = 'Periodic Review'
      )
      AND is_deleted = FALSE
  ),
  reqd_days AS (
    SELECT
      calendar_date,
      EXTRACT(day FROM calendar_date) AS day_in_calendar_date,
      day AS fiscal_day_name,
      day_of_week,
      week_start_date AS fiscal_week_begin_date,
      EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(calendar_date)) AS max_day_in_month,
      EXTRACT(MONTH FROM calendar_date) AS month,
      EXTRACT(YEAR FROM calendar_date) AS year,
      MAX(fiscal_week_in_month)
        OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM calendar_date),
            EXTRACT(
              MONTH
              FROM
                calendar_date)
        ) AS max_week_in_month,
      week_end_date AS fiscal_week_end_date,
      fiscal_year_week,
      fiscal_week_in_month,
      fiscal_month_in_quarter,
      INITCAP(LOWER(fiscal_month_name)) AS fiscal_month_name
    FROM
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_fiscal_date_mapping`
    WHERE
      fiscal_year_week IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year_week
        FROM
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_fiscal_date_mapping`
        WHERE
          calendar_date
          BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 70 day)
          AND LAST_DAY(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 4 year))
      )
  ),
  freq_daily AS (
    SELECT
      a.sh_name,
      a.start_date,
      a.end_date,
      a.frequency_type AS order_cycle,
      b.fiscal_day_name AS order_cycle_day,
      b.fiscal_year_week,
      b.calendar_date AS order_placement_date,
      b.fiscal_week_begin_date AS start_week_date,
      b.fiscal_week_end_date AS end_week_date,
      CASE
        WHEN
          calendar_date > LEAST(
            a.end_date, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 104 week))
          THEN 1
        ELSE 0
        END
        AS flag_for_post_two_years_date
    FROM
      scheduler a
    CROSS JOIN
      reqd_days b
    WHERE
      lower(a.frequency_type) = 'daily'
      AND (b.day_of_week BETWEEN 2 AND 6)
  ),
  freq_weekly AS (
    SELECT
      a.sh_name,
      a.start_date,
      a.end_date,

            '-',
            COALESCE(channel, '-'),
            '-',
            CAST(DATE(projected_delivery_date) AS STRING)) AS po_detail_id,

            AS po_detail_id_key,
          opm.*

          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_sku_hierarchy` AS paf
          USING (product_code)

      ),
      pseudo_po AS (
        SELECT
          CONCAT(
            product_code,
            '-',
            loc_code,
            '-',
            COALESCE(channel, '-'),
            '-',
            CAST(DATE(editable_expected_receipt_date) AS STRING))
            AS po_detail_id,

            AS po_detail_id_key,
          ooa.*
        FROM
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_orders_recommended_archive`
            AS ooa
        WHERE order_status_id = 3
      )
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CONCAT(
        product_code,
        loc_code,
        channel,
        CAST(order_placement_date AS STRING),
        CAST(order_placement_recom_date AS STRING),
        order_gen_type)
    FROM
      (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          pp.*,
          COALESCE(oclt.po_to_order_processing, 1) AS po_to_order_processing,

  );

WITH

    SELECT
      a.article,
      a.product_code,
      size,
      linked_store_code AS loc_code,
      a.fiscal_year_week,
      SUM(overall_proportion) AS aggregated_proportion,
    FROM
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_product_profile_weeks` a
    JOIN
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_sku_store_eligibility` b
      USING (
        product_code,
        store_code,
        fiscal_year_week)
    JOIN
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.store_dc_mapping` sdm
      USING (store_code)
    JOIN
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.distribution_centres` dc
      USING (dc_code)
    JOIN
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.dc_transit_time_mapping` dtt
      USING (mapping_code)
    JOIN
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_product_hybrid_attributes` pha
      ON
        a.product_code = pha.product_code
        AND pha.ordering = 'Y'
    WHERE
      sdm.is_active = TRUE
      AND dtt.priority=1
    GROUP BY
      1,
      2,
      3,
      4,
      5
  ),
  proportions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      fiscal_year_week,
      product_code,
      article,
      size,
      loc_code,
      aggregated_proportion,
      SUM(COALESCE(aggregated_proportion, 0))
        OVER (PARTITION BY fiscal_year_week, article, loc_code)
        AS total_proportion
    FROM
      final_data
  ),
  normalized AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      fiscal_year_week,
      article,
      product_code,
      size,
      loc_code,
      aggregated_proportion,
      total_proportion,
      CASE
        WHEN total_proportion = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(aggregated_proportion / total_proportion, 0)
        END
        AS normalized_proportion
    FROM
      proportions
  )
SELECT
  article,
  product_code,
  size,
  loc_code,
  '-' AS channel,
  fiscal_year_week,
  normalized_proportion AS penetration
FROM
  normalized
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  loc_code,
  article,
  size;

      USING (product_code)
    JOIN
      `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_constraints_lead_time` olt
      USING (article)
    CROSS JOIN
      (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          fiscal_year_week,
          week_start_date
        FROM
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_fiscal_date_mapping`
        WHERE
          calendar_date
          BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE
          AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 103 WEEK)
      )
    WHERE
      pha.ordering = 'Y'
  ),
  base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      article,
      loc_code,
      COALESCE(a.channel, b.channel, c.channel)
        AS channel,
      COALESCE(a.fiscal_year_week, b.fiscal_year_week, c.fiscal_year_week)
        AS fiscal_year_week_receipt,
      fdm.fiscal_year_week,
      COALESCE(a.mfp_units, b.mfp_units, c.mfp_units, 0) AS mfp_units
    FROM
      eligible_styles e
    LEFT JOIN
      lf a
      ON
        e.article = a.article
        AND e.fiscal_year_week = a.fiscal_year_week
    LEFT JOIN
      op b
      ON
        e.article = b.article
        AND e.fiscal_year_week = b.fiscal_year_week
        AND a.article IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN
      wp c

        e.article = b.article

WITH
  bse AS (
    SELECT
      rulename,
      CONCAT(
        CASE
          WHEN l2_name IS NULL OR l2_name = '' THEN ''
          ELSE CONCAT('l2_name::', l2_name, ';;')
          END,
        CASE
          WHEN l3_name IS NULL OR l3_name = '' THEN ''
          ELSE CONCAT('l3_name::', l3_name, ';;')
          END,
        CASE
          WHEN article IS NULL OR article = '' THEN ''
          ELSE CONCAT('article::', article, ';;')
          END) AS hierarchy,
      CONCAT(
        CASE
          WHEN l2_name IS NULL OR l2_name = '' THEN ''
          ELSE 'l2_name,'
          END,
        CASE
          WHEN l3_name IS NULL OR l3_name = '' THEN ''
          ELSE 'l3_name,'
          END,
        CASE
          WHEN article IS NULL OR article = '' THEN ''
          ELSE 'article,'
          END) AS level_column,  -- You can add the hierarchies which are required in Add RCL screen of Vendor Constraints Module 
      min_replenishment_quantity,
      max_replenishment_quantity,
      moq_interval,
      moq_tolerance,
      moq_start_month,
      order_multiple,
      level_of_application
    FROM
      (
        SELECT
          rule_name AS rulename,
          l2_name,
          l3_name,
          article,
          min_replenishment_quantity,
          max_replenishment_quantity,
          moq_interval,
          moq_tolerance,
          moq_start_month,
          order_multiple,
          level_of_application,
          COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY l2_name, l3_name, article) cnt
        FROM
          `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.oms_hierarchy_constraints`
      )
    WHERE
      cnt = 1
  ),
  ranked_bse AS (
    SELECT
      *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hierarchy ORDER BY hierarchy) AS row_num
    FROM
      bse
  )
SELECT DISTINCT
  rcl_code,
  CASE
    WHEN RIGHT(hierarchy, 2) = ';;'
      THEN SUBSTRING(hierarchy, 1, LENGTH(hierarchy) - 2)
    ELSE hierarchy
    END
    AS rcl_dimension,
  a.level,
  CAST(rulename AS string) AS rule_name,
  CAST('2000-01-01' AS date) AS start_date,
  CAST('2050-01-01' AS date) AS end_date,
  min_replenishment_quantity,
  max_replenishment_quantity,
  moq_interval,
  moq_tolerance,
  moq_start_month,
  order_multiple,
  level_of_application
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      *,
      CASE
        WHEN RIGHT(level_column, 1) = ','
          THEN SUBSTRING(level_column, 1, LENGTH(level_column) - 1)
        ELSE level_column
        END
        AS level
    FROM
      ranked_bse
    WHERE
      row_num = 1
      AND level_column <> ''
  ) a
JOIN
  `{Project ID}.{Dataset}.rcl_priority_mapping`
USING
  (level)

DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS public.sync_oms_rcl_constraints();

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE public.sync_oms_rcl_constraints()
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $procedure$
declare
	_log_code varchar := gen_random_uuid();
	_sp_name varchar := 'public.sync_oms_rcl_constraints';
	_log_step varchar;
	_st TIMESTAMP := clock_timestamp();
		_rcl_code int;
		_rcl_dt text;
		_rcl_jsonb text;
		_sql text;
    begin
	call global.data_ingestion_logs(_log_code, _sp_name, 'start', null, (clock_timestamp() - _st)::text, null);
	perform set_config('local.log_code', _log_code, true);
	perform set_config('local.sp_name', _sp_name, true);
	begin
	    with cte as (
			select r.rcl_code, r.level, rpm.rcl_priority
			from (
				select 
					array_agg(rcl_dimension order by rcl_dimension)::varchar[] as level,
					rcl_code 
				from  (
					select jsonb_object_keys(concat('{"',replace(replace(rcl_dimension,'::','":"'),';;','","'),'"}')::jsonb) as  rcl_dimension,
						   rcl_code
					from public.oms_constraint_master 
					group by 1,2
				)b 
				group by 2 
			)r
			join global.rcl_priority_mapping rpm using(level) 
			where module_code = 7001
		)
		insert into global.rcl_master 
			select
				rcl_code,
				7001,
				"level",
				'{}',
				'{[2022-07-01,2050-12-31)}',
				rcl_priority,
				false,
				251,
				null,
				now(),
				null 
			from cte  
			on conflict do nothing;
	    for _rcl_code, _rcl_dt, _rcl_jsonb in 
			select 
				x.rcl_code,
				string_agg(x.level || ' ' || y.generic_column_datatype, ', ') as _rcl_dt,
				string_agg(quote_literal(x.level) || ', ' || x.level, ', ') as _rcl_jsonb
			from (select rcl_code, unnest(level) as level from global.rcl_master) x 
			join global.product_generic_schema_mapping y 
			on x.level = y.generic_column_name 
			group by 1 loop
		execute '
				create temp table rcl_oms_constraint_master_rule_' || _rcl_code || ' on commit drop as
					    select rcl_code,
					        rule_name,
					        daterange(start_date, end_date) as validity,
					        cast(min_replenishment_quantity as float4) as min_replenishment_quantity,
					        cast(max_replenishment_quantity as float4) as max_replenishment_quantity,
					        cast(order_multiple as float8) as order_multiple,
					        cast(column_modified as varchar) as column_modified,
					        cast(moq_interval as varchar) as moq_interval,
					        cast(moq_tolerance as float4) as moq_tolerance,
					        cast(moq_start_month as varchar) as moq_start_month,
					        cast(level_of_application as varchar) as level_of_application,
					         cast(pack_selection as varchar) as pack_selection,
					        jsonb_build_object(' || _rcl_jsonb || ') as rcl_dimension from (
						select concat(''{"'',
				            replace(replace(rcl_dimension,
				            ''::'',
				            ''":"''),
				            '';;'',
				            ''","''),
				            ''"}'')::jsonb as rcl_dimension,
							cast(rcl_code as int4) as rcl_code,
							cast(null as varchar) as rule_name,
							start_date::date as start_date,
				            end_date::date as end_date,
							cast(min_replenishment_quantity as float4) as min_replenishment_quantity,
							cast(max_replenishment_quantity as float4) as max_replenishment_quantity,
                            cast(order_multiple as float8) as order_multiple,
                            cast(null as varchar(50)) as column_modified,
							cast(moq_interval as varchar) as moq_interval,
							cast(moq_tolerance as float4) as moq_tolerance,
							cast(moq_start_month as varchar) as moq_start_month,
							cast(level_of_application as varchar) as level_of_application,
							pack_selection
				   		from public.oms_constraint_master
				        where rcl_code = ' || _rcl_code || '
					) x, jsonb_to_record(rcl_dimension) as (' || _rcl_dt || ');';
			execute '
				insert
	            into
	            	oms.rcl_oms_constraint_master_rule (rcl_code, rule_name, rcl_dimension)
		        select
		            rcl_code,
					rule_name,
		            rcl_dimension
		        from
		            rcl_oms_constraint_master_rule_' || _rcl_code || '
		        on conflict do nothing;';
           
           execute ' 
					insert 
					into 
					oms.rcl_oms_constraint_master (rcl_code, 
					rule_code, 
					validity, 
					min_replenishment_quantity, 
					max_replenishment_quantity, 
					order_multiple, 
					moq_interval, 
					moq_tolerance, 
					moq_start_month, 
					column_modified, 
					level_of_application, 
					pack_selection,
					created_at,  
					created_by 
					) 
					select 
					rcl_code, 
					rule_code, 
					validity, 
					min_replenishment_quantity , 
					max_replenishment_quantity , 
					order_multiple, 
					moq_interval, 
					cast(moq_tolerance as float4) as moq_tolerance, 
					moq_start_month, 
					column_modified,  
					level_of_application, 
					pack_selection,
					now() as created_at, 
					251 as created_by  
					from rcl_oms_constraint_master_rule_' || _rcl_code || ' x 
					join oms.rcl_oms_constraint_master_rule y 
					using(rcl_code, rcl_dimension) 
					on conflict do nothing;';
	    end loop;
		call global.data_ingestion_logs(_log_code, _sp_name, 'end', null, (clock_timestamp() - _st)::text, null);
	exception
		when others then
	        -- Log the error if an exception occurs during any part of the procedure
	        call global.data_ingestion_logs(_log_code, _sp_name, _log_step, SQLERRM, (clock_timestamp() - _st)::text, null);
            raise exception 'Error occurred in the procedure: %', SQLERRM;
	end;
    end
$procedure$
;
